fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects disabling of Time Machine (Apple's automated backup utility software) via the native macOS backup utility "tmutil".
An attacker can use this to prevent backups from occurring.
fields.name: Time Machine Backup Disabled Via Tmutil - MacOS
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/tmutil" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "tmutil") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "disable"))
